verdict.rationale: Snyk documents a Remediation Agent that generates a fix plan, applies the fixes and verifies the result, available via `snyk fix --agentic` in the CLI or `/snyk-fix` and `/snyk-batch-fix` in coding assistants. DeepCode AI is described as powering security autofixes, and Snyk Open Source supports fix pull requests. Community reports criticize the quality and volume of dependency fix PRs but do not contradict that fixes are applied. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SAST code autofixes, detailed docs on the in-IDE apply-fix flow for Snyk Code findings, and evidence that fix-PR quality issues for dependencies are resolved.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply suggested or automatic code fixes for findings instead of only reading reports

citations.quote: It scans your Project with Snyk, generates a fix plan enriched with Snyk security intelligence, applies the fixes, and verifies the result
Run `snyk fix --agentic` from your terminal to trigger a human-in-the-loop interactive remediation experience without an IDE.
Run `/snyk-fix` in your coding assistant to scan the project and apply a fix for the top vulnerability. Use `/snyk-batch-fix` to address multiple issues at once.
supports workflows to fix vulnerabilities using pull requests
